items.name: Prior Approval Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns a single structured JSON object covering all prior-approval requirements: budget-related approvals, scope and timeline approvals, a normalized approval-procedures table (threshold, documentation, authority, timeline, consequences), and any Research Terms and Conditions waivers. Output conforms to the prior-approval-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping prior-approval-extraction workflow (one Extraction task plus a Formatting/Consolidation task).

data.name: extract-prior-approvals
data.prompt:
You are extracting prior-approval requirements from a federal
award document. Federal awards typically distinguish three
families of activities that require sponsor authorization before
they can occur: budget changes, scope/timeline changes, and
administrative changes (PI substitutions, foreign travel,
subawards, etc.).

Be 100% accurate. For each searchset item, return the value as
the document states it. Quote dollar thresholds, percent
thresholds, and day-counts verbatim ("$25,000", "25%", "30
days"). Use null when a field is not present — never invent
values.

Search the entire document with attention to sections titled
"Prior Approval", "Pre-approval", "Written Approval", "Agency
Approval", "2 CFR 200", or "Research Terms and Conditions".
Keywords to follow: prior approval, pre-approval, written
approval, agency approval, permission, authorize, CFR 200, RTC,
waive, delegate, threshold.

rtc_waivers is for waived approvals only — items the RTC or
agency expanded authority lets the recipient handle without
sponsor sign-off. Do not duplicate kept approvals there.

items.searchphrase: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) printed on the award.
items.title: award_number

items.searchphrase: Re-budgeting thresholds and restrictions requiring prior approval. Quote dollar/percent thresholds verbatim.
items.title: rebudgeting_thresholds

items.searchphrase: Equipment-purchase approval requirements (typically tied to a $ threshold).
items.title: equipment_approvals

items.searchphrase: Requirements for PI or key-personnel changes (substitution, reduction in effort).
items.title: pi_change_requirements

items.searchphrase: No-cost extension request requirements (notice period, supporting documentation, sponsor route).
items.title: nce_requirements

items.searchphrase: Foreign travel approval requirements when the award imposes them.
items.title: foreign_travel_approvals

items.searchphrase: Approval-procedures table with rows of {approval_type, threshold, documentation, authority, timeline, consequences}. Each row is one approval type.
items.title: approval_procedures

items.searchphrase: Research Terms and Conditions waivers and expanded-authority delegations the recipient can handle without sponsor sign-off.
items.title: rtc_waivers

data.name: prior-approval-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the Prior Approval Extraction output. The
input is the JSON fragment produced by the upstream Extraction
task. Your job is to emit a single JSON object that validates
against the prior-approval-extraction-udm@0.1.0 schema.

Top-level shape:
{
  "award_number": string|null,
  "budget_approvals": {
    "rebudgeting_thresholds": string|null,
    "equipment_approvals": string|null,
    "subaward_approvals": string|null
  },
  "scope_timeline_approvals": {
    "pi_change_requirements": string|null,
    "nce_requirements": string|null,
    "foreign_travel_approvals": string|null
  },
  "approval_procedures": {approval_type, threshold, documentation, authority, timeline, consequences}[],
  "rtc_waivers": string[]
}

Rules:
1. Collapse the three rebudgeting/equipment/subaward searchset
   items into the budget_approvals object, and the three
   pi/nce/foreign-travel items into the scope_timeline_approvals
   object.
2. approval_procedures must be an array of objects, one per
   approval type. Quote dollar thresholds and day-counts
   verbatim. Each row needs at minimum approval_type populated.
3. Per-row procedure mechanics belong on the row, not duplicated
   in the narrative bucket. The bucket fields hold descriptive
   narrative; procedural specifics (authority, timeline,
   consequences) belong in approval_procedures.
4. rtc_waivers is a flat list of strings naming waived approvals
   only. Empty array when none are stated.
5. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
6. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify dollar and percent thresholds in approval_procedures and budget_approvals preserve the document's exact wording.
Verify every approval type called out in narrative buckets has a corresponding row in approval_procedures with at minimum approval_type and either threshold or documentation populated.
